title: Qu Yuan and the Dragon Boat Festival
synopsis: Learn about the origin story behind traditions, including racing dragon boats and eating zongzi, during the Dragon Boat Festival.

fullText.simplified:
屈原与端午节

    端午节在每年的农历五月五日，它跟春节、清明节和中秋节一起，被称为中国的四大传统节日。说起端午节，人们都会想到吃粽子和赛龙舟，这两件事都跟中国的一个历史名人——屈原有关系。
    屈原是生活在两千多年前的人，当时的中国分为七个小国。七国之中最强大的国家是秦国。屈原所在的国家叫楚国，是现在中国的湖南、湖北一带。屈原是楚国重要的大臣，他提出楚国应该和其他小国联合起来，这样才能抵抗秦国的攻击。他还指出，国内有很多不好的现象，希望国王能做出改变。然而国王并不接受他的建议，许多大臣还在皇帝面前说屈原的坏话。慢慢地国王越来越不喜欢屈原了，他把屈原流放到了很远的地方。远离国王的屈原想到楚国的将来，他担心极了，也难过极了，写出许多浪漫而悲伤的长诗。后来，秦国攻打楚国，楚国败了。悲伤的屈原在五月五日这一天跳进汨罗江，结束了自己的生命。老百姓们听到这一消息，伤心极了。他们划着船，把大米扔进水里，希望江里的鱼来吃这些大米，不要吃屈原的身体。
    从此以后，人们就开始在每年的五月五日吃粽子、赛龙舟，纪念屈原。这就是屈原与端午节的故事。
    然而，事实上，端午节最早只是一个“卫生节”。农历五月是春末夏初，中国人觉得这是“阳气”开始的时间。这段时间要去外面晒太阳、运动，也要喝一点黄酒，让蚊子、害虫远离自己。
    屈原的故事出现以后，给端午节这一天添上了一层浪漫的色彩。人们希望自己身体健康，也希望国家强大。因此，端午节的时候，中国人不会说“端午节快乐”，而会说“端午安康”。
fullText.traditional:
屈原與端午節

    端午節在每年的農曆五月五日，它跟春節、清明節和中秋節一起，被稱為中國的四大傳統節日。說起端午節，人們都會想到吃粽子和賽龍舟，這兩件事都跟中國的一個歷史名人——屈原有關係。
    屈原是生活在兩千多年前的人，當時的中國分為七個小國。七國之中最強大的國家是秦國。屈原所在的國家叫楚國，是現在中國的湖南、湖北一帶。屈原是楚國重要的大臣，他提出楚國應該和其他小國聯合起來，這樣才能抵抗秦國的攻擊。他還指出，國內有很多不好的現象，希望國王能做出改變。然而國王並不接受他的建議，許多大臣還在皇帝面前說屈原的壞話。慢慢地國王越來越不喜歡屈原了，他把屈原流放到了很遠的地方。遠離國王的屈原想到楚國的將來，他擔心極了，也難過極了，寫出許多浪漫而悲傷的長詩。後來，秦國攻打楚國，楚國敗了。悲傷的屈原在五月五日這一天跳進汨羅江，結束了自己的生命。老百姓們聽到這一消息，傷心極了。他們划著船，把大米扔進水裡，希望江裡的魚來吃這些大米，不要吃屈原的身體。
    從此以後，人們就開始在每年的五月五日吃粽子、賽龍舟，紀念屈原。這就是屈原與端午節的故事。
    然而，事實上，端午節最早只是一個“衛生節”。農曆五月是春末夏初，中國人覺得這是“陽氣”開始的時間。這段時間要去外面曬太陽、運動，也要喝一點黃酒，讓蚊子、害蟲遠離自己。
    屈原的故事出現以後，給端午節這一天添上了一層浪漫的色彩。人們希望自己身體健康，也希望國家強大。因此，端午節的時候，中國人不會說“端午節快樂”，而會說“端午安康”。

sentences.traditional: 它跟春節、清明節和中秋節一起，
sentences.pinyin: tā gēn chūn jié qīng míng jié hé zhōng qiū jié yì qǐ
sentences.english: The Dragon Boat Festival happens every year on the fifth day of the fifth month of the lunar calendar.

sentences.simplified: 被称为中国的四大传统节日。
sentences.traditional: 被稱為中國的四大傳統節日。
sentences.pinyin: bèi chēng wéi zhōng guó de sì dà chuán tǒng jié rì
sentences.english: Along with the Spring Festival, the Tomb-Sweeping Festival, and the Mid-Autumn Festival, ..

sentences.simplified: 说起端午节，人们都会想到吃粽子和赛龙舟，
sentences.traditional: 說起端午節，人們都會想到吃粽子和賽龍舟，
sentences.pinyin: shuō qǐ duān wǔ jié rén men dōu huì xiǎng dào chī zòng zi hé sài lóng zhōu
sentences.english: .. it is referred to as one of China’s four major traditional festivals.

sentences.simplified: 这两件事都跟中国的一个历史名人——屈原有关系。
sentences.traditional: 這兩件事都跟中國的一個歷史名人——屈原有關係。
sentences.pinyin: zhè liǎng jiàn shì dōu gēn zhōng guó de yí ge lì shǐ míng rén qū yuán yǒu guān xi
sentences.english: When it comes to the Dragon Boat Festival, people will think of eating zongzi and racing dragon boats.
These two things are both related to a famous Chinese historical figure, Qu Yuan.

sentences.simplified: 屈原是生活在两千多年前的人，当时的中国分为七个小国。
sentences.traditional: 屈原是生活在兩千多年前的人，當時的中國分為七個小國。
sentences.pinyin: qū yuán shì shēng huó zài liǎng qiān duō nián qián de rén dāng shí de zhōng guó fēn wéi qī ge xiǎo guó

sentences.simplified: 七国之中最强大的国家是秦国。
sentences.traditional: 七國之中最強大的國家是秦國。
sentences.pinyin: qī guó zhī zhōng zuì qiáng dà de guó jiā shì qín guó
sentences.english: Qu Yuan lived around 2,000 years ago. At that time, China was split into seven small states.

sentences.simplified: 屈原所在的国家叫楚国，是现在中国的湖南、湖北一带。
sentences.traditional: 屈原所在的國家叫楚國，是現在中國的湖南、湖北一帶。
sentences.pinyin: qū yuán suǒ zài de guó jiā jiào chǔ guó shì xiàn zài zhōng guó de hú nán hú běi yí dài
sentences.english: Of the seven states, the most powerful was the state of Qin.

sentences.simplified: 屈原是楚国重要的大臣，
sentences.traditional: 屈原是楚國重要的大臣，
sentences.pinyin: qū yuán shì chǔ guó zhòng yào de dà chén
sentences.english: The state that Qu Yuan lived in was called the state of Chu, which is the modern-day region of Hunan and Hubei in China.

sentences.simplified: 他提出楚国应该和其他小国联合起来，
sentences.traditional: 他提出楚國應該和其他小國聯合起來，
sentences.pinyin: tā tí chū chǔ guó yīng gāi hé qí tā xiǎo guó lián hé qǐ lái
sentences.english: Qu Yuan was an important minister of the state of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 这样才能抵抗秦国的攻击。
sentences.traditional: 這樣才能抵抗秦國的攻擊。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng cái néng dǐ kàng qín guó de gōng jī
sentences.english: He suggested that the state of Chu should form an alliance with the other small states.

sentences.simplified: 他还指出，国内有很多不好的现象，希望国王能做出改变。
sentences.traditional: 他還指出，國內有很多不好的現象，希望國王能做出改變。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái zhǐ chū guó nèi yǒu hěn duō bù hǎo de xiàn xiàng xī wàng guó wáng néng zuò chū gǎi biàn
sentences.english: Only in this way could they resist the attack of the State of Qin.

sentences.simplified: 然而国王并不接受他的建议，许多大臣还在皇帝面前说屈原的坏话。
sentences.traditional: 然而國王並不接受他的建議，許多大臣還在皇帝面前說屈原的壞話。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér guó wáng bìng bù jiē shòu tā de jiàn yì xǔ duō dà chén hái zài huáng dì miàn qián shuō qū yuán de huài huà
sentences.english: He also pointed out that there were many bad things happening in the country, and he hoped that the king could make changes.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地国王越来越不喜欢屈原了，他把屈原流放到了很远的地方。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地國王越來越不喜歡屈原了，他把屈原流放到了很遠的地方。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de guó wáng yuè lái yuè bù xǐ huan qū yuán le tā bǎ qū yuán liú fàng dào le hěn yuǎn de dì fang
sentences.english: However, the king did not accept his suggestions, and many ministers even spoke ill of Qu Yuan in front of the monarch.

sentences.simplified: 远离国王的屈原想到楚国的将来，他担心极了，
sentences.traditional: 遠離國王的屈原想到楚國的將來，他擔心極了，
sentences.pinyin: yuǎn lí guó wáng de qū yuán xiǎng dào chǔ guó de jiāng lái tā dān xīn jí le
sentences.english: Over time, the king grew to dislike Qu Yuan, and he exiled Qu Yuan to a faraway place.

sentences.simplified: 也难过极了，写出许多浪漫而悲伤的长诗。
sentences.traditional: 也難過極了，寫出許多浪漫而悲傷的長詩。
sentences.pinyin: yě nán guò jí le xiě chū xǔ duō làng màn ér bēi shāng de cháng shī
sentences.english: When Qu Yuan, who was now far away from the king, thought about the future of the state of Chu, he was extremely worried.

sentences.simplified: 后来，秦国攻打楚国，楚国败了。
sentences.traditional: 後來，秦國攻打楚國，楚國敗了。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái qín guó gōng dǎ chǔ guó chǔ guó bài le
sentences.english: He was also very sad, and he wrote many long poems that were both romantic and sad.

sentences.simplified: 悲伤的屈原在五月五日这一天跳进汨罗江，结束了自己的生命。
sentences.traditional: 悲傷的屈原在五月五日這一天跳進汨羅江，結束了自己的生命。
sentences.pinyin: bēi shāng de qū yuán zài wǔ yuè wǔ rì zhè yì tiān tiào jìn mì luó jiāng jié shù le zì jǐ de shēng mìng
sentences.english: Later, the state of Qin attacked the State of Chu, and the state of Chu was defeated.

sentences.simplified: 老百姓们听到这一消息，伤心极了。
sentences.traditional: 老百姓們聽到這一消息，傷心極了。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎi xìng men tīng dào zhè yī xiāo xi shāng xīn jí le
sentences.english: The sorrowful Qu Yuan jumped into the Miluo River on the fifth day of the fifth month, ending his own life.

sentences.simplified: 他们划着船，把大米扔进水里，
sentences.traditional: 他們划著船，把大米扔進水裡，
sentences.pinyin: tā men huá zhe chuán bǎ dà mǐ rēng jìn shuǐ lǐ
sentences.english: The people were extremely sad to hear this news.

sentences.simplified: 希望江里的鱼来吃这些大米，不要吃屈原的身体。
sentences.traditional: 希望江裡的魚來吃這些大米，不要吃屈原的身體。
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng jiāng lǐ de yú lái chī zhè xiē dà mǐ bú yào chī qū yuán de shēn tǐ
sentences.english: They rowed boats and threw rice into the river.
They hoped that the fish in the Miluo River would come and eat this rice rather than eat Qu Yuan’s body.

sentences.simplified: 从此以后，人们就开始在每年的五月五日吃粽子、赛龙舟，纪念屈原。
sentences.traditional: 從此以後，人們就開始在每年的五月五日吃粽子、賽龍舟，紀念屈原。
sentences.pinyin: cóng cǐ yǐ hòu rén men jiù kāi shǐ zài měi nián de wǔ yuè wǔ rì chī zòng zi sài lóng zhōu jì niàn qū yuán

sentences.simplified: 这就是屈原与端午节的故事。
sentences.traditional: 這就是屈原與端午節的故事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì qū yuán yǔ duān wǔ jié de gù shi
sentences.english: Since then, people began eating zongzi and racing dragon boats every year on the fifth day of the fifth month to commemorate Qu Yuan.
This is the story of Qu Yuan and the Dragon Boat Festival.

sentences.simplified: 然而，事实上，端午节最早只是一个“卫生节”。
sentences.traditional: 然而，事實上，端午節最早只是一個“衛生節”。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér shì shí shàng duān wǔ jié zuì zǎo zhǐ shì yí ge wèi shēng jié

sentences.simplified: 农历五月是春末夏初，
sentences.traditional: 農曆五月是春末夏初，
sentences.pinyin: nóng lì wǔ yuè shì chūn mò xià chū
sentences.english: However, in fact, the Dragon Boat Festival was originally just a “health festival”.

sentences.simplified: 中国人觉得这是“阳气”开始的时间。
sentences.traditional: 中國人覺得這是“陽氣”開始的時間。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén jué de zhè shì yáng qì kāi shǐ de shí jiān
sentences.english: The fifth month of the lunar calendar is the end of spring and the beginning of summer.

sentences.simplified: 这段时间要去外面晒太阳、运动，
sentences.traditional: 這段時間要去外面曬太陽、運動，
sentences.pinyin: zhè duàn shí jiān yào qù wài miàn shài tài yáng yùn dòng
sentences.english: Chinese people believe this is the time when “yang energy” begins.

sentences.simplified: 也要喝一点黄酒，让蚊子、害虫远离自己。
sentences.traditional: 也要喝一點黃酒，讓蚊子、害蟲遠離自己。
sentences.pinyin: yě yào hē yì diǎn huáng jiǔ ràng wén zi hài chóng yuǎn lí zì jǐ
sentences.english: During this period, people should go outside in the sun and exercise.
They should also drink some yellow rice wine to keep mosquitoes and pests away.

sentences.simplified: 屈原的故事出现以后，给端午节这一天添上了一层浪漫的色彩。
sentences.traditional: 屈原的故事出現以後，給端午節這一天添上了一層浪漫的色彩。
sentences.pinyin: qū yuán de gù shi chū xiàn yǐ hòu gěi duān wǔ jié zhè yì tiān tiān shàng le yì céng làng màn de sè cǎi

sentences.simplified: 人们希望自己身体健康，也希望国家强大。
sentences.traditional: 人們希望自己身體健康，也希望國家強大。
sentences.pinyin: rén men xī wàng zì jǐ shēn tǐ jiàn kāng yě xī wàng guó jiā qiáng dà
sentences.english: After the story of the Qu Yuan emerged, a layer of romance was added onto the day of the Dragon Boat Festival.

sentences.simplified: 因此，端午节的时候，中国人不会说“端午节快乐”，
sentences.traditional: 因此，端午節的時候，中國人不會說“端午節快樂”，
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ duān wǔ jié de shí hou zhōng guó rén bú huì shuō duān wǔ jié kuài lè
sentences.english: People hope to be healthy, and they hope for their country to be powerful.

sentences.simplified: 而会说“端午安康”。
sentences.traditional: 而會說“端午安康”。
sentences.pinyin: ér huì shuō duān wǔ ān kāng
sentences.english: Therefore, during the Dragon Boat Festival, Chinese people won’t say, “Happy Dragon Boat Festival”.

sentence_translations: Qu Yuan and the Dragon Boat Festival
The Dragon Boat Festival happens every year on the fifth day of the fifth month of the lunar calendar.
Along with the Spring Festival, the Tomb-Sweeping Festival, and the Mid-Autumn Festival, ..
.. it is referred to as one of China’s four major traditional festivals.
When it comes to the Dragon Boat Festival, people will think of eating zongzi and racing dragon boats.
These two things are both related to a famous Chinese historical figure, Qu Yuan.
Qu Yuan lived around 2,000 years ago. At that time, China was split into seven small states.
Of the seven states, the most powerful was the state of Qin.
The state that Qu Yuan lived in was called the state of Chu, which is the modern-day region of Hunan and Hubei in China.
Qu Yuan was an important minister of the state of Chu.
He suggested that the state of Chu should form an alliance with the other small states.
Only in this way could they resist the attack of the State of Qin.
He also pointed out that there were many bad things happening in the country, and he hoped that the king could make changes.
However, the king did not accept his suggestions, and many ministers even spoke ill of Qu Yuan in front of the monarch.
Over time, the king grew to dislike Qu Yuan, and he exiled Qu Yuan to a faraway place.
When Qu Yuan, who was now far away from the king, thought about the future of the state of Chu, he was extremely worried.
He was also very sad, and he wrote many long poems that were both romantic and sad.
Later, the state of Qin attacked the State of Chu, and the state of Chu was defeated.
The sorrowful Qu Yuan jumped into the Miluo River on the fifth day of the fifth month, ending his own life.
The people were extremely sad to hear this news.
They rowed boats and threw rice into the river.
They hoped that the fish in the Miluo River would come and eat this rice rather than eat Qu Yuan’s body.
Since then, people began eating zongzi and racing dragon boats every year on the fifth day of the fifth month to commemorate Qu Yuan.
This is the story of Qu Yuan and the Dragon Boat Festival.
However, in fact, the Dragon Boat Festival was originally just a “health festival”.
The fifth month of the lunar calendar is the end of spring and the beginning of summer.
Chinese people believe this is the time when “yang energy” begins.
During this period, people should go outside in the sun and exercise.
They should also drink some yellow rice wine to keep mosquitoes and pests away.
After the story of the Qu Yuan emerged, a layer of romance was added onto the day of the Dragon Boat Festival.
People hope to be healthy, and they hope for their country to be powerful.
Therefore, during the Dragon Boat Festival, Chinese people won’t say, “Happy Dragon Boat Festival”.
Instead, they will say, “Good health for the Dragon Boat Festival”.
